general.notes: Typical reach stated as 300m @ OM3 fiber (not converted to km per exact copy rule). Power consumption stated as < 1W; 1.0 W listed as the numeric bound in the datasheet. Operating temperature table shows -0°C to +70°C. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Power budget 0 – 5.1dB. Transmitter/receiver power values are average power per footnote 1). Minimum input power -11.1dBm at 8.5Gbps, BER 1x10-12, back-to-back per footnote 2). Protocol support includes 1G, 2G, 4G, 8G FC, GbE. Bit rate support 0.6Gbps to 8.5Gbps; ordering description Multirate 614Mbps-8.5Gbps.
general.suggestions: Consider a reach field in meters or allow quoted units from the source. Clarify whether -0°C should be stored as 0. Clarify handling of inequality bounds such as < 1W for power_consumption_w.
